    "Model forecasts are consistently 2-4 euros too high compared to true outcomes",
    "Bias is strongest at 30-60 day horizons where model still assumes upward momentum",
    "The 7-day ahead forecast is often 1-2 euros higher than actuals when prices are declining",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model fails to adjust quickly enough, creating 3-5 euro divergence",
    "Mean reversion bias exists: model over-estimates price persistence from declining trends",
    "Sentiment positive values ( >0.67) provide no forecast improvement over neutral",
    "When history shows 5+ day price decline, subtract 1.5*current forecast for 30-day horizon"
] }
